name: Middle Purple
lede: Middle Purple is a muted purplish pink, a Crayola crayon name from the Munsell-based line of 1926 to 1944.

sections.title: A Munsell-era crayon
sections.body:
Middle Purple was one of Crayola's Munsell line, sold from 1926 to 1944, whose names used "middle" where later boxes said "medium" [3]. [[seafoam-teal|Middle Blue Green]] came from the same line [3]. Our library files the name as an alternate of [[pink-orchid|Pink Orchid]], which shares its exact hex [1].

The swatch is pinker than the name suggests: on screen it reads as a soft orchid pink rather than a purple [1]. Its nearest named neighbor by measured color is [[light-rosolane-purple]] at 3.2 units, more vivid, with [[light-mallow-purple]] and [[persian-pink]] at about five [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive carries a color within four units of this one over at least one percent of its canvas, as photographed [2]. That says something about this archive and its mix of museums and periods, not about painting as a whole [2].
